Quick update — Sam (our CIO) just let us know he will be traveling on Oct 12 and can’t attend the live demo. Two asks: can you confirm whether a VP is an acceptable substitute from Redwood’s side, and if so, who would be the point person on Redwood’s executive team?

Ben, can you lead as the exec sponsor if Tom (Astrum VP) wants a business/ROI discussion? I’ll draft a quick update to Elena proposing the two options. Attaching a slimmed-down runbook for the Oct 12 flow so we’re all clear on roles.
